title_sq: Tek Rezidenca Kodra E Diellit 2, Shitet Super Apartament 3+1, Me Super Pamje Dhe Me Cmim Okazion !
description_sq: Ne nje nga komplekset me te mira ne Tirane, tek Rezidenca Kodra e Diellit 2, shitet super apartament (triplex) 3+1+3, i investuar totalisht dhe me cmim okazion. Apartamenti organizohet ne katin e pare nga korridori hyres, nje tualet dhe nje magazine (depo), ne katin e dyte nga salloni i ndenjes i bollshem se bashku me ambientin e gatimit dhe me dalje ne verande, nje dhome gjumi matrimoniale me dalje ne ballkon, kurse kati i trete organizohet nga dy dhoma te bollshme dhe dy tualete. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i investuar nga pronari duke filluar qe nga instalimet elektrike dhe hidraulike te cilat jane multistrad te reja, parketin i cili eshte AC5, vetratat duplex me gaz argon te cilat mundesojne pervec izolimit akustik gjithashtu dhe nje izolim termik qe bere bashke me faktin qe apartamenti ka sistem kapot ofron temperatura sa me optimale ne apartament. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i mobiluar. Apartamenti te gjitha investim dhe punimet e gipsit i ka te kryera me arkitekt dhe jane te kompozuar ne menyren me te mire te mundshme. Orientimi eshte nga Lindja cka e ben nje apartament te ekspozuar ndaj drites se diellit ne pjesen me te mire te dites gjithashtu nga veranda ofron pamje te lire nga qyteti dhe mali i Dajtit. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nje zone e cila eshte shume e kerkuar pasi ofron te gjitha sherbimet e nevojshme per nje jetese sa me komode, me ajer te paster dhe nje zone mjaft e qete. Kompleksi aksesohet dhe nga linja e transportit publik qe te sjell deri tek hyrja e rezidences. Apartamenti pervec faktit qe eshte shume i pershtatshem per banim eshte shume i pershtatshem edhe per investim pasi zona ka kerkesa te larta qeraje.
title_en: At Residence Kodra E Diellit 2, Super Apartment 3+1 For Sale, With Super View And Bargain Price!
description_en: In one of the best complexes in Tirana, at Rezidenca Kodra e Diellit 2, a super apartment (triplex) 3+1+3 is for sale, fully invested and at a bargain price. The apartment is organized on the first floor by the entrance corridor, a toilet and a warehouse (storage), on the second floor by a spacious living room together with the cooking area and exit to the veranda, a matrimonial bedroom with access to the balcony, while the third floor is organized by two spacious rooms and two toilets. The apartment is totally invested by the owner, starting from the electrical and plumbing installations which are new multistrad, the parquet which is AC5, the duplex windows with argon gas which enable, in addition to acoustic insulation, also a thermal insulation which, together with the fact that the apartment has a capot system, offers the most optimal temperatures in the apartment. The apartment is fully furnished. The apartment has all investment and plaster works done by an architect and they are composed in the best possible way. The orientation is from the East, which makes the apartment exposed to the sunlight in the best part of the day, also from the veranda offers a clear view of the city and the mountain of Dajti. The area in which the apartment is located is an area that is very sought after as it offers all the necessary services for a comfortable life, with clean air and a quite quiet area. The complex is also accessible by the public transport line that will bring you to the entrance of the residence. Apart from the fact that it is very suitable for living, the apartment is also very suitable for investment as the area has high rent requirements.
